blocks.text: `run_scenario` runs a predefined test with pass/fail criteria and prints a criteria table (PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED).

r = run_scenario('S1');                    % RC drive, saved to work/results
r = run_scenario('S1', 'StopTime', 20);    % shorter run
r = run_scenario('S6c');                   % trailing letter = variant
r = run_scenario('S8', 'Variant', 'a', 'Viz', 1);   % live bird's-eye view
R = run_all_scenarios({'S0', 'S1', 'S6c'});         % several scenarios
